@sketch
Feature: Rectangle two point

  @acceptance @documented_observation @needs_fixture
  Scenario: rectangle-two-point-01 Create a rectangle from opposite corners
    Given the MCAD Software is running
    And an editable planar sketch
    When the user select Two Point Rectangle and click diagonally opposite corners
    Then four connected sides form an axis-aligned closed rectangle
    When the user press Escape
    Then the rectangle remains and the sketch is Ready





  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: rectangle-two-point-06 Cancel before the opposite corner
    Given an editable sketch is Ready
    When the user choose Rectangle Two Point and click the fixture first corner
    Then the prompt requests the opposite corner
    When the user press Escape
    Then the MCAD Software returns to Ready without a new rectangle

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: rectangle-two-point-07 Keep selecting after identical corner clicks
    Given an editable sketch is Ready
    When the user invoke Two Point Rectangle
    And the user click the same fixture position for both corners
    Then Select opposite corner remains active
    And both dynamic size fields display 0,000 mm
    And no error dialog or rectangle appears
    When the user press Escape
    Then the MCAD Software returns to Ready

  @documented_observation @needs_fixture @numeric_input @undo_redo
  Scenario: rectangle-two-point-08 Commit typed sizes and restore through history
    Given an editable sketch in RIGHT view with the required fixture
    When the user start Two Point Rectangle and select a first corner
    And the user press 1 and then 0
    And the user press Tab
    And the user press 6 and then Enter
    Then a rectangle with size annotations 10 and 6 is committed
    And the command returns to Select first corner
    When the user press Escape and then Ctrl+Z
    Then the rectangle and its two size annotations disappear
    When the user press Ctrl+Y
    Then the rectangle and both annotations return

  @documented_observation @measurement @needs_fixture
  Scenario: rectangle-two-point-09 Verify the numeric rectangle edge lengths
    Given the recorded numeric rectangle in RIGHT view has been restored
    When the user open Measure and select its vertical edge away from endpoints
    Then Selection 1 is a Curve with Length 10.000 mm
    When the user click empty canvas and select its horizontal edge away from endpoints
    Then Selection 1 is a Curve with Length 6.000 mm
    When the user click Done
    Then Measure closes and the rectangle remains

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: rectangle-two-point-10 Observe a zero first size
    Given the recorded fixture sketch is Ready with 22 dimensions needed
    When the user choose Two Point Rectangle and the fixture first corner
    And the user enter 0 and press Tab
    Then the first size is locked at 0.000 mm and the second field is focused
    When the user enter 4 and press Return
    Then the command returns to Select first corner without a warning dialog
    And the immediate status temporarily shows 24 dimensions needed
    When the user press Escape
    Then Ready returns with 22 dimensions needed and no new rectangle visible

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: rectangle-two-point-11 Retain a numeric rectangle
    Given a fresh Two Point Rectangle command in the recorded sketch view
    And the existing ellipse from the recorded fixture is visible
    When the user select the fixture first corner, enter 6, press Tab, enter 4 and press Return
    Then the rectangle shows height 6 and width 4
    And the rectangle extends upward and rightward in the recorded view
    And it overlaps part of the existing ellipse
    When the user press Escape
    Then the rectangle remains and Ready returns

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: rectangle-two-point-12 Cancel a rectangle height proposal
    Given the rectangle height editor is open with 6 mm selected
    When the user enter 8 and press Escape
    And the user reopen the height annotation
    Then the height editor still contains 6 mm

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: rectangle-two-point-13 Accept and undo a rectangle height edit
    Given the numeric rectangle retains height 6 and width 4 annotations
    When the user accept height 8 mm and exit General Dimension
    Then the rectangle extends downward while its top edge stays in place in the recorded view
    And the width annotation remains 4
    When the user open Measure and select the left edge
    Then Measure reports the selected left edge length as 8.000 mm
    When the user close Measure and undo the height edit
    Then the visible height annotation returns to 6
    When the user redo the height edit
    Then the visible height annotation returns to 8
    And width annotation 4 remains

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: rectangle-two-point-14 Observe a zero second size
    Given the recorded sketch is Ready with the 4-by-8 rectangle retained
    When the user start Two Point Rectangle and click the fixture first corner
    And the user enter 4, press Tab, enter 0 and press Return
    Then Select first corner returns without a warning or a visible new rectangle
    When the user press Escape
    Then Ready returns and the prior rectangle remains
